reviewBasis: Operator correction identifying the movement as stretching while walking into the gym

correctedActionTimeline.observation: Fully clothed subject walks away from the camera into the gym and begins raising both arms.
Subject continues walking with both arms overhead, elbows bent, making a loose shoulder and triceps stretch with a small side-to-side adjustment.
Subject releases the stretch and lowers both arms while maintaining forward gait.
Subject continues walking deeper into the gym with arms relaxed and gradually recedes in the fixed frame.

continuity: The dark T-shirt and lower-body clothing remain on throughout; no undressing, back reveal or bodybuilding flex occurs.
camera: Locked rear-facing vertical camera; the subject's decreasing size is caused by walking away, not a zoom.
playback: Natural real-time gait is visually supported by step cadence, clothing motion and carried-item swing.
